title: SBA Encourages Americans to Shop Small on Small Business Saturday®, November 29th

facts.fact: The page states that Small Business Saturday, created by American Express, has generated over $220 billion for independent retailers, restaurants, and service-based businesses since it began in 2010; this figure is an aggregate of consumer self-reported survey spend commissioned by American Express.
facts.quote: has generated over $220 billion* for independent retailers, restaurants, and service-based businesses since it began in 2010.

facts.fact: The page states that estimated spending at local merchants on Small Business Saturday in 2024 was around $22 billion, based on consumer self-report from an American Express-commissioned survey.
facts.quote: In 2024, the estimated spending at local merchants on Small Business Saturday was around$22 billion***.

facts.fact: According to American Express, small business owners surveyed expect nearly 20% of their annual revenue to come from sales on Small Business Saturday alone.
facts.quote: small business owners surveyed expect nearly 20%** of their annual revenue to come from sales on Small Business Saturday alone.

facts.fact: The SBA states that Small Business Saturday has been co-sponsored by the SBA since 2011.
facts.quote: Small Business Saturday has been co-sponsored by the SBA since 2011.

facts.fact: The page announces Small Business Saturday for 2025 as falling on November 29th.
The 2025 American Express Shop Small Impact Study's small business owner survey was conducted online among a sample of 500 U.S. small business owners/managers from September 29 to October 8, 2025.
facts.quote: a sample of 500 small business owners/managers in the U.S. from September 29 – October 8, 2025.

facts.fact: The 2024 American Express Small Business Saturday Consumer Insights Survey used a nationally representative sample of 2,601 U.S. adults aged 18 or older.
facts.quote: nationally representative sample of 2,601 U.S. adults 18 years of age or older.

facts.fact: The 2024 American Express Small Business Saturday Consumer Insights Survey was conducted on November 30, 2024.
facts.quote: It was conducted anonymously on November 30, 2024.

facts.fact: Eligible respondent companies in the small business owner survey must conduct sales in a physical location in arts/entertainment/recreation, retail trade, restaurant/bar/coffee shop/hotel/hospitality, or personal services industries.
facts.quote: Respondent companies must conduct sales in a physical location in one of the following industries

facts.fact: The page notes that the 2024 consumer spend figure is based on self-report and does not reflect actual receipts, sales, or American Express Card Member spending data.
facts.quote: The spend figure is based on consumer self-report and does not reflect actual receipts or sales from Small Business Saturday

facts.fact: The SBA's cosponsorship of this activity is listed under Cosponsorship Authorization #25-35-C.
